evidence.source: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.text: The dictionary records 嗎 as a colloquial variant of 罵 and explains that use as 口 (meaning category) plus 馬 (sound), specifically for the scold sense. It also notes 嗎 has a separate proper-character entry; this phonetic analysis therefore should not automatically be extended to the question particle.
evidence.title: [A03210-003] 嗎 (罵) - Ministry of Education Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants

evidence.source: Edith Aldridge, “Neg-to-Q: The Historical Origin and Development of Question Particles in Chinese,” The Linguistic Review 28.4 (2011), pp. 411–447
evidence.text: Aldridge proposes that the spoken Mandarin question particle developed from negative existential 無. The paper gives Tang-era clause-final 無 examples, reports that from the ninth century 無 was often written 麼 in questions, and says 嗎 later replaced that spelling. This grammatical history is distinct from the graphic formation of 嗎; it does not establish the first attestation of 嗎 as a particle.
evidence.title: Neg-to-Q: The Historical Origin and Development of Question Particles in Chinese

search_audit.query: 嗎 口 馬 俗罵字 教育部 字源; site:dict.variants.moe.edu.tw/dictView.jsp 嗎 罵 俗字 口 馬; Edith Aldridge Neg-to-Q question particles Chinese 無 嗎 2011
search_audit.outcome: Searched and opened the Ministry of Education dictionary entry and Aldridge article. The MOE entry supports the 口＋馬 analysis specifically for 嗎 as 罵; Aldridge addresses the spoken particle’s grammatical history and later spelling, not the graph’s construction.

gaps: The 字源 corpus search found no 嗎/吗 headword entry. Its mentions were in the common-character list and Pinyin appendix. I inspected both original scans directly; neither provides etymological evidence, so the book cannot support an authored etymology claim here.
No book OCR correction is proposed: the inspected scans agree with the relevant OCR content at the occurrences used, and no suspicious etymological passage was found.
The reviewed online material does not establish an early dated attestation for the graph 嗎 in the question-particle use or a complete semantic path from clause-final 無 through 麼 to 嗎.
